entities.summary: Estelle Asmodelle, formerly known as Estelle Maria Croot, is an Australian polymath and transgender activist. She has also worked as a model, actress, belly dancer, musician, abstract artist, and physicist. On 13 October 1987, she became the first legal transgender person in Australia to be recognised by the Births, Deaths and Marriages Department of New South Wales. She was the first Australian trans person to receive a passport with a revised gender marker. In 1986, she was referred to as "Australia’s First Sex-Change Pin-up Girl" and has received media coverage since the 1980s.
